title: C-level Magic Student Who Thinks He Is SSS Class
description:
The strongest man in school usually hides his true strength and acts like an ordinary student…… 

There was a man who staked his life on such a Mousou. Shion Ichinose, an ordinary student attending Crawford Magic Academy. Shion continued to behave like an "SSS-Rank" both inside and outside the school, but his eccentric behavior eventually involved those around him……? 

Only his Mousou and acting are SSS-Rank! The "strongest" mistaken Hero tale of a single, crazy C-Rank magic student grandly opens here!!
author: NKMR
